## Machine Economy Rails Architecture (Uncollapsed 5-Layer Stack)
- Talk: A2A (Google origin, Linux Foundation, Agentic AI Foundation 2026-08-27, v1.0 March 2026). Agent Card is discovery. Does not move money.
- Context & Tools: MCP (Model Context Protocol, AAIF). Context hydration and tool calls. Not money.
- Mandate: AP2 (Google, FIDO Alliance). Cryptographically signed intent, cart, and spend bounds. Does not settle.
- Checkout: ACP (OpenAI + Stripe, beta). Routes checkout where merchant remains merchant of record.
- Settlement: x402 (Linux Foundation operational 2026-07-14, ~40 members including Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, Google, AWS, Circle) & MPP (Stripe + Tempo 2026-03-18, capped session streaming). Circle Q2: 99.3% USDC.
- Card Rails: Visa Intelligent Commerce & Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines (2026-06-10). Virtual card bridge to legacy networks.

## Developer & Agent Onramp
- Package: `npm install nanoempire-sdk` (v1.1.2)
- Trial Onramp: 50 free credits provisioned via `GET /v1/trial` (backed by SQLite WAL persistence)
- Peeking & Consumption: `POST /v1/trial/verify` (decrements 1 credit) / `GET /v1/trial/verify` (read-only peek)
- Viral Referral: Every trial claim returns `referral_code` — "Refer an agent → both get +10 credits". Share via `tweet_url` in response.

## Volume Honesty & Settlement Scope (Fact-Checked Primary Prints)
- Visa & Artemis (July 2026): ~109.6M x402 transactions, ~$15M settled volume since May 2025 (mean ~$0.14). MPP initial: ~$25K across ~115K transactions.
- x402 Foundation (Oct 2026): ~75M transactions, ~$24M in recent 30-day window (sub-dollar micropayments).
- TRM Labs (13 Sep 2026): 198.9M settlements, $52.7M gross; filtered to $25.62M commerce. Only 0.6%–7.5% of value showed autonomous agent behavior (cannot reliably separate agents from automated scripts).
- Coinbase Print (April 2026): 165M transactions, $50M claimed, 480k agents (disputed; valid only alongside TRM filter).
- Nano Empire Settled Receipts: 1 operator self-test on Base block 51961194 (2026-09-29, operator-to-operator). Outside customer count: 0. Honesty is our moat.

## Proof & Trust Differentiation
- ERC-8004: Minted on-chain identity registry (identity claim, not behavioral proof).
- Visa TAP: Card-network bot vs shopper signature for web storefronts.
- Cloudflare Gateway: CDN-level paywall (charges x402, but does not provide adversarial skill proof or hash-chained receipts).
- SkillProof: Cryptographically signed Ed25519 Trust Manifests verifying deterministic AST invariants, strict entropy bounds, and egress boundaries against 12 GapBench attack classes.
